name: Safari Zone
lines:
It’s my job to go about checking up
on the health of all the Pokémon.
Having so many Pokémon together
in one area means we have to be
extra careful of the spread of illness.

You know, we call this place the Safari Zone,
but it’s really no different than any wild area.
There are no cages or walls. The Pokémon
are free to come and go as they like.
